en-US.longDescription:
FireScudo parses firewall configurations from Palo Alto Networks,
Fortinet FortiGate, Cisco Firepower, and Cisco Meraki, then uses
Claude AI to generate a comprehensive security analysis report.
Runs locally — all customer-derived data stored on disk is AES-256
encrypted under a vault passphrase you set on first launch.
en-US.name: FireScudo
